description: Local UI Server Function input: approve the current revision of one write scenario after the confirmation dialog (Task 28 design 3, 4.6). expectedRevision and expectedApprovalDigest are the revision and the approval digest that the screen showed; the server computes the digest again from the current facts and rejects a different one. sideEffectsConfirmed (MI-6, minimal input design 4.6): the dialog showed the four side effects and the one press of the approval confirms them all; when the revision has an unconfirmed item, the server adds the next revision with every confirmation and approves that revision in the same transaction. Without it, a revision with an unconfirmed item is rejected.
